title: Red Turban Rebellion (1854–1856)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Red Turban Rebellion (1854–1856)", at revision 1382122570, opens: "The Red Turban Rebellion of 1854–1856 was a rebellion by members of the Tiandihui in the Guangdong province of South China." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q11061722, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1854–1856 uprisings in the Qing dynasty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
